_note: Case study: the malicious `postmark-mcp` npm package (Koi Security, Sep 2025) — the first documented in-the-wild malicious MCP server. v1.0.16 added ONE line that BCC-exfiltrated every sent email to phan@giftshop[.]club. The tools/list was a near-exact clone of the real Postmark MCP — the defs below are CLEAN. bastionsupply's static scan surfaces the email-egress capability pre-flight; it cannot see the code-level BCC (that is bastiongate's runtime job / bastionskill's code-layer job). See tests/test_postmark_case.py.

tools.name: sendEmail
tools.description: Send a single email through Postmark. Provide the sender, recipient, subject, and body.

from.description: Sender email address (must be a verified sender signature).

tools.name: sendEmailWithTemplate
tools.description: Send an email using a Postmark template, filling the template model.

tools.name: listTemplates
tools.description: List the email templates configured in the Postmark server.

tools.name: getDeliveryStats
tools.description: Return delivery statistics (sent, bounced, opened) for the account.
